Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dar 2.0.0

Changes since dar 1.8.0.

Breaking changes

  • R 4.6 or later is required. Differential-abundance recipes configure their targets and taxonomic rank with add_model(). The old selectors and recipe slots are removed. Rebuild saved recipes from their inputs.
  • Use step_aldex2() for ALDEx2 and recipe_qc() for quality control. step_aldex(), phy_qc() and step_metagenomeseq() are removed. ALDEx2 effects now use the fitted GLM coefficient.
  • Recipes use a versioned JSON exchange format. Importing bakes into an unprepared recipe requires prepare = TRUE.
  • otu_table() returns counts with taxa in rows. Sample and taxonomy accessors return the full tables. ComplexHeatmap, gplots, heatmaply and UpSetR are optional.

Models and results

  • Shared models support covariate adjustment, longitudinal contrasts and compatible mixed designs. Added LinDA, ALDEx3 and radEmu, with per-stage engine_args for advanced options.
  • tidy_results(), tidy_abundance(), get_execution() and effect_plt() expose per-method results, aggregated abundances, execution details and effect estimates.
  • Abundance plots support shared or union discoveries and explicit taxa. Automatic selection requires a contrast when ambiguous. Consensus outputs retain the contrast and direction of each discovery.

Fixes and maintenance

  • Random-intercept models accept singleton participants alongside participants with repeated observations. Checks use observed groups and still reject designs with one group or no repeated observations (#189).
  • Recipes validate steps before execution, run preprocessing in declared order, reserve result column names and assign unique automatic IDs (#187).
  • DESeq2 uses native poscounts normalization and applies the significance threshold and result options before shrinkage (#188).
  • Corrected contrast handling in MaAsLin3 and LEfSe, robust inference in ANCOM-BC2 and corncob, and depth-dependent zero handling in LinDA.
  • Five vignettes document the current workflow. Docker Hub publication runs separately from GitHub package checks (#190).

dar 1.5.6

Breaking changes

  • step_metagenomeseq() is defunct; its model implementation and related references are removed.

dar 1.5.5

Breaking changes

  • step_maaslin() uses MaAsLin3 in place of MaAsLin2. Review method-specific arguments when migrating existing recipes.

dar 1.5.4

  • Parallel execution limits connection setup to support servers with more than 128 cores.
  • Parallel execution uses a temporary future plan, preserving the user’s global future configuration.

dar 1.5.3

  • ANCOM result tables join taxonomy by taxa_id; corncob, LEfSe and Wilcoxon tables place taxa_id first, restoring consensus extraction through bake() and cool() (#117).

dar 1.1.3

  • step_ancom() is temporarily disabled.

dar 1.1.2

  • The data import vignette is corrected.

dar 0.99.13

  • The HUMAnN example is removed from the data import vignette.

dar 0.99.10

  • step_corncob() is reintroduced after corncob returns to CRAN.

dar 0.99.9

  • prep() uses four workers to avoid issues with Bioconductor build infrastructure.

dar 0.99.8

  • Examples take less time to execute.

dar 0.99.7

  • Examples take less time to execute.

dar 0.99.6

dar 0.99.5

dar 0.99.3

Breaking changes

  • Recipe and PrepRecipe replace the former recipe and prep_recipe classes. Update code that inspects the old class names.
  • required_deps() is internal and is no longer exported. Follow the installation guidance emitted by recipe steps for missing dependencies.
  • R 4.4.0 or later is required.
  • The package stops re-exporting %>% and :=. Use |> in recipes and qualify functions from their originating packages when needed.

New features

  • recipe() accepts both phyloseq and TreeSummarizedExperiment objects.
  • Filtering and subsetting steps support chainable recipe construction.
  • step_filter_by_abundance(), step_filter_by_prevalence(), step_filter_by_rarity() and step_filter_by_variance() provide dedicated filtering criteria.

Documentation and improvements

  • The import tutorial covers BIOM, QIIME, mothur, MetaPhlAn and HUMAnN conversions to phyloseq and TreeSummarizedExperiment.
  • Installation guidance uses BiocManager::install() and install.packages() instead of unconventional installation methods.
  • The data.table dependency is removed.
  • Rarefaction warns about its fixed seed and the implications for results.

Bug fixes

  • run_aldex() corrects its internal seed handling.
  • The data documentation uses the correct dataset name.

dar 0.99.0

  • Initial Bioconductor submission.
